name: KubeGuard MCP Server
description: Enables security analysis of Kubernetes Role configurations using LLM-assisted prompt chaining and rule-based assessment. Provides comprehensive security scoring, hardened role generation, and runtime permission usage correlation to identify privilege escalation risks and over-permissive configurations.
